chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem narrated to us, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Abdullah al-Khalnaji, from Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said: I asked Al-Rida (peace be upon him)

about the opening Takbirat, so he said: Seven. I said: It has been narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he used to say Takbir once. He said: Indeed, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to say Takbir once, pronouncing it loudly, and saying it quietly six times.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَاتِ الِافْتِتَاحِ: Opening Takbirs (Allahu Akbar) at the beginning of prayer

ai.seo_question: How many times is the opening Takbir said in prayer according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the number of opening Takbirs in prayer, stating there are seven in total. He reconciles the differing narrations by explaining that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) pronounced one Takbir loudly and the remaining six quietly.
